sentence: An approver must decide a complete EXC-100 within 2 business days of receiving it [S1][S2].
The count starts on the first business day after the EXC-100 is complete in the loan system [S1].
A request decided late is still valid, but the delay is recorded [S1].
The HEL-1 minimum payment is the interest charged for the month, so it is interest-only [S1].
Interest is calculated daily on the drawn balance at the HEL-1 contract rate and charged to the line each month [S1].
For HEL-1, the contract rate is DMC Prime plus 0.75 [S3].
The minimum payment changes when DMC Prime or the drawn balance changes [S1].
It does not reduce the amount borrowed, and Mortgage Operations shows it on each statement [S1].
A self-employed borrower must have been in business for at least 2 years before the application [S1].
POL-008 also sets the minimum time in business at at least 2 years [S3].
Yes, if the deposit is meant for your down payment, the Underwriter will ask where it came from. [S1][S2]
A single large deposit within the 90-day savings history must be explained and documented. [S2]
Acceptable explanations include the sale of a property, a bonus shown on a pay stub, or a gift that meets the rules. [S2]
If the deposit looks like loan proceeds, the Underwriter must ask for proof of its source. [S1]
Borrowed money may not be counted toward the down payment. [S1]
The sources do not say that accelerated payments let an FX5-C borrower get around the prepayment limits. [S1][S2]
FX5-C borrowers have a lump-sum privilege of up to 18% of the original principal and a payment-increase privilege of up to 18% of the current regular payment in each anniversary year. [S2]
Accelerated frequencies are based on the monthly payment and repay the mortgage faster than the matching standard frequencies. [S1]
Staff must not describe an accelerated frequency as a way to avoid the prepayment limits in POL-009. [S1]
Fixed-rate interest on FX3-C is compounded semi-annually. [S1][S3]
Mortgage Operations converts the stated annual rate to a payment-period rate using i = (1 + r / 2)^(2 / f) - 1, where r is the annual rate as a decimal and f is the number of payments per year. [S3]
Each FX3-C payment is calculated under this method and rounded to the cent. [S2]
No, an FX5-C mortgage is for an owner-occupied residential property, and a non-owner-occupied property is lent on under RNT-4 and not under FX5-C [S1].
Demo Mortgage Co. lends on a property the borrower will not live in only under RNT-4 [S5].
The HEL-1 contract rate is DMC Prime plus 0.75 points [S3].
Step 1: On the rate sheet effective 2026-11-01, DMC Prime is 4.70% [S3].
Step 2: 4.70% plus 0.75 points equals 5.45% [S3].
The HEL-1 rate is therefore 5.45% on that rate sheet [S3].
The rate changes whenever DMC Prime changes, and without a rate hold it is the rate on the rate sheet in force on the funding date [S3].
Three months' interest is the interest on the amount prepaid for 3 months at the contract rate [S2].
The sources give this example: a 30,000 prepayment above the privileges at a contract rate of 4.69% [S1].
Three months' interest is 30,000 x 4.69% / 4 = 351.75 [S1].
For each salaried job, your client must supply two documents [S1].
A recent pay stub showing the pay period, year-to-date earnings and the employer's name [S1]
An employment letter from the employer, dated within 30 days of the credit decision, stating the position, employment status, start date and base pay [S1][S3]
Underwriting counts each job separately, so the same two documents are needed for both jobs [S1].
For each job, the pay stub and employment letter must agree on base pay, or the difference must be resolved with the borrower before a decision is made [S1].
